subject: Token & feature metrics + next asks (Ava Health)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doyle <jane.doyle@avahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Token & feature metrics + next asks (Ava Health)

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and three concrete asks so we can put together a crisp pricing proposal that ties to your engineering goals. I focused the notes on the "appointment-intake automation" feature you described.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary feature: automated patient intake + triage prompt chain (profile + symptom triage + routing). Expected average prompt depth ~650 tokens per end-user session, peak flows up to 1,200 tokens for complex conversations.
- Monthly active sessions (initial): 45k sessions/month; target scale scenario we modeled: 200k sessions/month in 12 months.
- Primary KPI for commercials: target contribution margin >= 65% after inference cost.
- Desired CAC payback: ideally <= 6 months for paid acquisition cohorts.

Three asks (so we can run a tight unit-econ model)
1) Confirm the baseline monthly sessions you want us to price (45k vs 200k growth scenario). If you want both, let us know which should be the "pilot" and which is the "scale".
2) Share an approximate blended LTV (or ARPU per converted user) or your expected feature-level revenue (e.g., $/activated patient per month). Even a range is fine (e.g., $0.50–$2.00 / activated patient).
3) Any strict budget ranges for inference cost? You mentioned a target of "$X per 1M tokens" in passing — can you put a rough $/1M tokens target (or a monthly inference budget) so we can map back to margin & payback.

What we'll provide next (deliverables)
- A 2-sheet econ model (pilot and scale) that outputs: $/feature (per activated user), $/1M tokens implied, inference cost as % of feature revenue, and CAC payback months given your inputs.
- Suggested pricing bands and a recommended Redwood serving configuration (batching / caching / quantization assumptions) that hit your margin target.

I've attached a draft scenario workbook (econ-scenario-v1.xlsx) with placeholders — we'll fill with your numbers once you confirm the asks above.

Proposed next step: if you can send the three items above by EOD tomorrow, we can turn around the model and a recommended pricing structure by Friday. Otherwise we can schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk through live.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Principal Solutions — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Token & feature metrics + next asks (Ava Health)

Thanks Grace — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers inline and a few clarifications below.

1) Baseline vs scale: please price both. Pilot = 45k sessions/mo (6-week pilot with targeted invite list). Scale = 200k sessions/mo (12 months).
2) Blended ARPU: for the patient-activated cohort we expect ~$1.25/month on average in year 1 (range $0.9 - $1.6). We can split pilot cohort projections if helpful.
3) Budget target: our procurement lead asked for an inferred target of <$30 / 1M tokens (we know this is aggressive; open to tradeoffs on latency and accuracy). If you can show options that hit <$30 and a separate "quality-first" option at market rates, that'd be helpful.

Additional notes:
- CAC: our goal is 4–5 month payback on paid acquisition cohorts for this feature. We can accept 6 months if the trial results are strong.
- Security: SOC 2 attestation is table stakes; we'll ask for the evidence during procurement.

We'll attach a short pilot acceptance criteria doc later today — sending it to rev-ops for input.

Best,
Jane
VP Product — Ava Health
jane.doyle@avahealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Token & feature metrics + next asks (Ava Health)

Hey Jane — thanks for the ranges, that helps a lot. I ran a quick pass on the workbook with the numbers you provided and left two scenarios in sheet tabs: PILOT and SCALE. Top-level highlights (very rough, assumptions noted in workbook):

PILOT (45k sessions/mo, 650 tokens avg)
- Implied tokens/mo: ~29.25M tokens
- If we hit $30 / 1M tokens -> monthly inference cost ~ $877.50
- If feature ARPU = $1.25 / activated user -> revenue/mo ~ $56,250 -> inference is ~1.6% of revenue; contribution margin easily above 65% before CAC.
- CAC payback at current funnel metrics (CAC = $18 / paid user) -> payback ~14.4 months (pilot low-conversion) — requires us to optimize conversion or lower CAC for pilot to hit target.

SCALE (200k sessions/mo, 650 tokens avg)
- Implied tokens/mo: ~130M tokens
- $30 / 1M tokens -> inference cost/mo ~ $3,900
- Revenue/mo (ARPU $1.25) ~ $250,000 -> inference ~1.56% of revenue; margin looks sustainable.
- With CAC = $18 and better conversion assumptions at scale, payback moves toward 4–6 months depending on conversion uplift.

Key levers we want to explore with you:
- Token reduction for common flows via KV caching and prompt trimming (saves up to 15–30% tokens on average).
- Quantization profile that preserves accuracy but reduces inference unit-cost (we'll show tradeoffs for Q4_8 vs FP16).
- Routing to a cheaper model variant for non-critical sessions to hit the <$30/1M tokens band while keeping a quality-first path for complex sessions.

I'll update the attached workbook with these adjusted scenarios and a simple CAC payback table. Grace — can you confirm if we should run an accuracy-impact check (sample prompts) on the scale path?
